mainEntity.name: How long does it take to develop a comprehensive set of AI-ready FAQs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for developing a comprehensive set of AI-ready FAQs can vary significantly depending on the volume and complexity of the information, as well as the resources available. For a moderately sized business with existing data, the initial development phase might take anywhere from 4 to 8 weeks. This includes data analysis, content drafting, optimization, and initial integration. Larger projects with extensive knowledge bases or specialized technical information could extend to several months. It's also important to factor in ongoing maintenance and updates, as AI systems require continuous content refinement to remain effective and current.
acceptedAnswer.description: Developing AI-ready FAQs typically takes 4-8 weeks for a moderate project, but can extend to several months for larger ones, depending on content volume and complexity. Ongoing maintenance is also required.
